//: Navigation and shell-state builtins. None of these can touch the filesystem, the network, or a process: they move the shell's own cwd or set its own variables. They live at BASE level, not inside profile-planning/, because loadRulesMulti merges per command name and lookup is `rules.get(name) ?? rules.get("*")` -- a named rule never falls through to the wildcard, so one file fixes planning AND awaiting_verification at once. Without this, `cd /repo && git log` is DENIED in planning even though git log is explicitly allowed by git.json, because mostRestrictive([deny, allow]) is deny and the message then names only cd.
reason: Navigation and shell-state builtins cannot mutate anything outside the shell itself.
